rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. It shares the child's precise subject matter—articles containing at least 45 percent butterfat—the same milk-and-butterfat price-support predicate, the same section 22 investigation machinery, a nearly identical sequence of findings, and extensive matching language. The child adapts C17's quota proclamation into a broader prohibition with enumerated exceptions. C16 and C15 share the general section 22 proclamation structure and much operative phrasing, but lack C17's distinctive butterfat-specific material.

shared_material.child_excerpt: certain articles containing butterfat ... are being or are practically certain to be imported ... as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with, the price-support program ... with respect to milk and butterfat
shared_material.parent_excerpt: butter substitutes, including butter oil, containing 45 per centum or more of butterfat ... are practically certain to be imported ... as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with, the price-support program ... with respect to milk and butterfat
shared_material.explanation: The shared language combines the same specific commodity characteristic, import finding, and protected agricultural program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in accordance with the said section 22, as implemented by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 23, 1935, the said Tariff Commission has made such investigation and has reported to me its findings and recommendations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in accordance with the said section 22, as implemented by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 23, 1935, the said Tariff Commission has made such investigation and has reported to me its findings and recommendations
shared_material.explanation: This is an essentially verbatim and relatively distinctive procedural recital.

shared_material.child_excerpt: articles containing 45 percent or more of butterfat ... shall not be permitted to be entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the total aggregate quantity of butter substitutes, including butter oil, containing 45 per centum or more of butterfat ... which shall be permitted to be entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption
shared_material.explanation: The operative provision preserves the same 45-percent threshold and customs-entry machinery while changing a quantitative quota into a prohibition subject to exceptions.
